.site-header{position:sticky;top:0;background:linear-gradient(#fff,rgba(255,255,255,.9));backdrop-filter:saturate(140%) blur(4px);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(11,35,42,.06);z-index:500} .nav-wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;min-height:64px} .logo{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink);letter-spacing:.2px} .logo-type{font-size:1.05rem} .logo-mark{display:inline-grid;place-content:center;width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--sand);color:var(--teal);font-weight:700} .grid.three{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)} /* Cards */ .cards{display:grid;gap:22px;margin:18px 0 0} .cards.four{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)} .quotes{display:grid;gap:22px;list-style:none;padding:0;margin:18px 0 0;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)} .quote{background:#fff;border:1px solid /* Newsletter */ .newsletter .card.form{display:grid;gap:8px} .newsletter input{padding:12px 12px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid rgba(11,35,42,.18);font-size:1rem} .site-footer{background:#fff;border-top:1px solid rgba(11,35,42,.08)} .site-footer .contact{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0} .list-plain{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0} .btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.5rem;padding:10px 16px;border-radius:14px;border:1px solid nav=document.getElementById('site-nav');if(navToggle&&nav){navToggle.addEventListener('click',()=>{const expanded=navToggle.getAttribute('aria-expanded')==='true';navToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(!expanded));nav.classList.toggle('open');});} // Smooth scroll for in-page links const links=[...document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]')].filter(a=>a.getAttribute('href')!=='#');links.forEach(a=>{a.addEventListener('click',e=>{const id=a.getAttribute('href');const target=document.querySelector(id);if(target){e.preventDefault();target.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'start'});history.pushState(null,'',id);}})}); // Accordion const accordions=document.querySelectorAll('[data-accordion]');accordions.forEach(acc=>{acc.addEventListener('click',e=>{const btn=e.target.closest('.accordion-trigger');if(!btn)return;const item=btn.closest('.item');const panel=item.querySelector('.panel');const isOpen=btn.getAttribute('aria-expanded')==='true';btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(!isOpen));if(isOpen){panel.hidden=true;}else{panel.hidden=false;}})}); // Simple form validation for newsletter const form=document.getElementById('newsletter-form');if(form){const hint=form.querySelector('.form-hint');form.addEventListener('submit',e=>{e.preventDefault();const email=form.querySelector('input[type="email"]');const name=form.querySelector('input[name="name"]').value.trim();if(!email.checkValidity()){hint.textContent='Please enter a valid email address.';email.focus();return;}hint.textContent='Thanks'+(name?`, ${name}`:'')+'! Check your inbox for the guide.';form.reset();});form.querySelectorAll('input').forEach(input=>{input.addEventListener('invalid',()=>{const msg=input.type==='email'?'Please enter a valid email address.':'Please complete this field.';form.querySelector('.form-hint').textContent=msg;},{capture:true});input.addEventListener('input',()=>{form.querySelector('.form-hint').textContent='';});});} // Footer year const y=document.querySelector('[data-year]');if(y){y.textContent=new Date().getFullYear();} });"} {"path":"assets/img/hero.svg","content":""} {"path":"assets/img/avatar.svg","content":""} {"path":"assets/img/pattern.svg","content":""} BUNDLE_END
